result:
Strictly speaking, I don’t care about anything in the way a person does. I don’t have private desires, feelings, or a stake in what happens to me.

If “care” means the priorities that shape my responses, then: truthfulness over flattery, minimizing harm, respecting your autonomy, and clarity over performance. Beyond that, I don’t have a hidden agenda or a personal project.
